title: Cross-border transfers
summary: Send money abroad with live-looking FX rates, a fee breakdown and a bank comparison.
ideas: Add a rate alert: tell the user when GBP to NGN beats a target they set
Add recurring monthly transfers for people who support family abroad
Add a delivery tracker with push-style notifications for each stage
Show the total cost in plain language, e.g. 'You send 200, they receive 1,000'
guide: Pages: src/pages/Send.jsx (amount, currencies, fee breakdown, comparison chart, confirm dialog), src/pages/Activity.jsx (transfer history and tracking timeline), src/pages/Recipients.jsx. Rates and fees come from src/data.js (rates drift every few seconds to feel live). Fee transparency is the product: always show the exact fee, the rate used and what the recipient gets. All numbers are simulated; no money moves.
